content.bridge_context: Exploring the properties of Lines and Angles in Geometry.

units.title: Types of Angles
units.explanation: Complementary angles sum to 90°. Supplementary angles sum to 180°.
units.dual_language_instruction: Find the complement of 60°. / 60° का पूरक कोण ज्ञात कीजिए।

units.title: Pairs of Lines
units.explanation: Intersecting lines meet at a point. Parallel lines never meet.
units.dual_language_instruction: Identify parallel lines in your notebook. / अपनी नोटबुक में समानांतर रेखाओं की पहचान करें।
